Bases: object

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶
get_center(bound=None)[source]¶

Query the current center frequency for the capture. Returned as Hz. By passing the MIN or MAX arguments, the user can query the upper and lower frequency limits for a capture.

Parameters:

bound – ‘MIN’ or ‘MAX’ to query frequency limits, or None for current center.

Returns:

The center frequency in Hz, or the min/max limit.

get_center_step()[source]¶

Query the center frequency step size in Hz.

Returns:

The center frequency step size in Hz.

get_ifbwidth()[source]¶

Query the IF bandwidth for the capture.

Returns:

The IF bandwidth in Hz.

get_rlevel()[source]¶

Query the current reference level for the capture.

Returns:

The current reference level as dBm.

get_srate()[source]¶

Query the sample rate of the capture.

Returns:

The sample rate in Hz.

get_sweep_time()[source]¶

Query the overall acquisition length of the capture in seconds.

Returns:

The sweep time in seconds.

is_ifbwidth_auto()[source]¶

Query if automatic IF bandwidth selection is enabled for the capture.

Returns:

True if auto IF bandwidth is enabled, False otherwise.

set_center(freq)[source]¶

Set the measurement center frequency for the capture.

Parameters:

freq – Center frequency in Hz, or ‘UP’, or ‘DOWN’.

set_center_step(freq)[source]¶

Set the step amount the center frequency changes by when using the UP or DOWN parameters on the CENTer command.

Parameters:

freq – Step amount for center frequency changes in Hz.

set_ifbwidth(freq)[source]¶

Specify the IF bandwidth for the capture. Only active when AUTO is set to false.

Parameters:

freq – IF bandwidth in Hz.

set_ifbwidth_auto(state)[source]¶

Enable or disable automatic IF bandwidth selection for the capture. When enabled, the Spike software will automatically choose an appropriate IF bandwidth for the measurement.

Parameters:

state – 1/0 or ‘ON’/’OFF’ to enable/disable auto IF bandwidth.

set_rlevel(amplitude)[source]¶

Set the reference level for the capture.

Parameters:

amplitude – Reference level in dBm.

set_srate(freq)[source]¶

Specify the sample rate of the capture. This determines how much decimation will be applied to the full signal.

Parameters:

freq – Sample rate in Hz.

set_sweep_time(value)[source]¶

Set the overall acquisition length of the capture in seconds.

Parameters:

value – Sweep time in seconds.

class ZS_Fetch(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶

Bases: object

The Fetch commands are used to retrieve measurement results in zero-span mode.

__init__(instrument, data_handler)[source]¶
get_zs(param)[source]¶

Fetch I/Q data and other measurement parameters. The integer parameter specifies which to retrieve. 1. I/Q data in ASCII or binary format (see “I/Q Data” section above) 2. Length of I/Q data. This is the number of complex I/Q data points (eg. (I1, Q1) is a single point). 10. Average power as reported on the AM vs Time plot. Returned as dBm.

Parameters:

param – 1 for I/Q data, 2 for length, 10 for average power.

Returns:

I/Q data (str), length (int), or average power (float).
